shortDescription: Configuration for CS virtual server resource.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: apiprofile
options.description: The API profile where one or more API specs are bounded to.

options.name: appflowlog
options.description: Enable logging appflow flow information

options.name: authentication
options.description: Authenticate users who request a connection to the content switching virtual server.

options.name: authenticationhost
options.description: FQDN of the authentication virtual server. The service type of the virtual server should be either HTTP or SSL.

options.name: authn401
options.description: Enable HTTP 401-response based authentication.

options.name: authnprofile
options.description: Name of the authentication profile to be used when authentication is turned on.

options.name: authnvsname
options.description: Name of authentication virtual server that authenticates the incoming user requests to this content switching virtual server.

options.name: backuppersistencetimeout
options.description: Time period for which backup persistence is in effect.

options.name: backupvserver
options.description: Name of the backup virtual server that you are configuring. Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at sign (@), equal sign (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Can be changed after the backup virtual server is created. You can assign a different backup virtual server or rename the existing virtual server. options.name: cacheable
options.description: Use this option to specify whether a virtual server, used for load balancing or content switching, routes requests to the cache redirection virtual server before sending it to the configured servers.

options.name: casesensitive
options.description: Consider case in URLs (for policies that use URLs instead of RULES). For example, with the C(ON) setting, the URLs /a/1.html and /A/1.HTML are treated differently and can have different targets (set by content switching policies). With the C(OFF) setting, /a/1.html and /A/1.HTML are switched to the same target.

options.name: clttimeout
options.description: Idle time, in seconds, after which the client connection is terminated. The default values are: 180 seconds for HTTP/SSL-based services. 9000 seconds for other TCP-based services. 120 seconds for DNS-based services. 120 seconds for other UDP-based services.

options.name: comment
options.description: Information about this virtual server.

options.name: cookiename
options.description: Use this parameter to  specify the cookie name for COOKIE peristence type. It specifies the name of cookie with a maximum of 32 characters. If not specified, cookie name is internally generated.

options.name: dbprofilename
options.description: Name of the DB profile.

options.name: disableprimaryondown
options.description: Continue forwarding the traffic to backup virtual server even after the primary server comes UP from the DOWN state.

options.name: dnsoverhttps
options.description: This option is used to enable/disable DNS over HTTPS (DoH) processing.

options.name: dnsprofilename
options.description: Name of the DNS profile to be associated with the VServer. DNS profile properties will applied to the transactions processed by a VServer. This parameter is valid only for DNS and DNS-TCP VServers.

options.name: domainname
options.description: Domain name for which to change the time to live (TTL) and/or backup service IP address.

options.name: downstateflush
options.description: Flush all active transactions associated with a virtual server whose state transitions from UP to DOWN. Do not enable this option for applications that must complete their transactions.

options.name: dtls
options.description: This option starts/stops the dtls service on the vserver

options.name: httpprofilename
options.description: Name of the HTTP profile containing HTTP configuration settings for the virtual server. The service type of the virtual server should be either HTTP or SSL.

options.name: httpsredirecturl
options.description: URL to which all HTTP traffic received on the port specified in the -redirectFromPort parameter is redirected.

options.name: icmpvsrresponse
options.description: Can be active or passive

options.name: insertvserveripport
options.description: Insert the virtual server's VIP address and port number in the request header. Available values function as follows:         C(VIPADDR) - Header contains the vserver's IP address and port number without any translation.         C(OFF)     - The virtual IP and port header insertion option is disabled.         C(V6TOV4MAPPING) - Header contains the mapped IPv4 address corresponding to the IPv6 address of the vserver and the port number. An IPv6 address can be mapped to a user-specified IPv4 addres

options.name: ipmask
options.description: IP mask, in dotted decimal notation, for the IP Pattern parameter. Can have leading or trailing non-zero octets (for example, 255.255.240.0 or 0.0.255.255). Accordingly, the mask specifies whether the first n bits or the last n bits of the destination IP address in a client request are to be matched with the corresponding bits in the IP pattern. The former is called a forward mask. The latter is called a reverse mask.

options.name: ippattern
options.description: IP address pattern, in dotted decimal notation, for identifying packets to be accepted by the virtual server. The IP Mask parameter specifies which part of the destination IP address is matched against the pattern. Mutually exclusive with the IP Address parameter. For example, if the IP pattern assigned to the virtual server is 198.51.100.0 and the IP mask is 255.255.240.0 (a forward mask), the first 20 bits in the destination IP addresses are matched with the first 20 bits in the pattern. options.name: ipset
options.description: The list of IPv4/IPv6 addresses bound to ipset would form a part of listening service on the current cs vserver

options.name: ipv46
options.description: IP address of the content switching virtual server.

options.name: l2conn
options.description: Use L2 Parameters to identify a connection

options.name: listenpolicy
options.description: String specifying the listen policy for the content switching virtual server. Can be either the name of an existing expression or an in-line expression.

options.name: listenpriority
options.description: Integer specifying the priority of the listen policy. A higher number specifies a lower priority. If a request matches the listen policies of more than one virtual server the virtual server whose listen policy has the highest priority (the lowest priority number) accepts the request.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: mssqlserverversion
options.description: The version of the MSSQL server

options.name: mysqlcharacterset
options.description: The character set returned by the mysql vserver.

options.name: mysqlprotocolversion
options.description: The protocol version returned by the mysql vserver.

options.name: mysqlservercapabilities
options.description: The server capabilities returned by the mysql vserver.

options.name: mysqlserverversion
options.description: The server version string returned by the mysql vserver.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the content switching virtual server. Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at sign (@), equal sign (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Cannot be changed after the CS virtual server is created. The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, my serve

options.name: netprofile
options.description: The name of the network profile.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: newname
options.description: New name for the virtual server. Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at sign (@), equal sign (=), and hyphen (-) characters. The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my name" or 'my name').

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: oracleserverversion
options.description: Oracle server version

options.name: persistencebackup
options.description: Backup persistence type for the virtual server. Becomes operational if the primary persistence mechanism fails.

options.name: persistencetype
options.description: Type of persistence for the virtual server. Available settings function as follows: * C(SOURCEIP) - Connections from the same client IP address belong to the same persistence session. * C(COOKIEINSERT) - Connections that have the same HTTP Cookie, inserted by a Set-Cookie directive from a server, belong to the same persistence session. * C(SSLSESSION) - Connections that have the same SSL Session ID belong to the same persistence session.

options.name: persistmask
options.description: Persistence mask for IP based persistence types, for IPv4 virtual servers.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for content switching virtual server.

options.name: precedence
options.description: Type of precedence to use for both C(RULE)-based and C(URL)-based policies on the content switching virtual server. With the default (C(RULE)) setting, incoming requests are evaluated against the rule-based content switching policies. If none of the rules match, the C(URL) in the request is evaluated against the C(URL)-based content switching policies.

options.name: probeport
options.description: Citrix ADC provides support for external health check of the vserver status. Select port for HTTP/TCP monitring

options.name: probeprotocol
options.description: Citrix ADC provides support for external health check of the vserver status. Select C(HTTP) or C(TCP) probes for healthcheck

options.name: probesuccessresponsecode
options.description: HTTP code to return in SUCCESS case.

options.name: push
options.description: Process traffic with the push virtual server that is bound to this content switching virtual server (specified by the Push VServer parameter). The service type of the push virtual server should be either HTTP or SSL.

options.name: pushlabel
options.description: Expression for extracting the label from the response received from server. This string can be either an existing rule name or an inline expression. The service type of the virtual server should be either HTTP or SSL.

options.name: pushmulticlients
options.description: Allow multiple Web 2.0 connections from the same client to connect to the virtual server and expect updates.

options.name: pushvserver
options.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server, of type PUSH or SSL_PUSH, to which the server pushes updates received on the client-facing load balancing virtual server.

options.name: quicprofilename
options.description: Name of QUIC profile which will be attached to the Content Switching VServer.

options.name: range
options.description: Number of consecutive IP addresses, starting with the address specified by the IP Address parameter, to include in a range of addresses assigned to this virtual server.

options.name: redirectfromport
options.description: Port number for the virtual server, from which we absorb the traffic for http redirect

options.name: redirectportrewrite
options.description: State of port rewrite while performing HTTP redirect.

options.name: redirecturl
options.description: URL to which traffic is redirected if the virtual server becomes unavailable. The service type of the virtual server should be either HTTP or SSL. Caution: Make sure that the domain in the URL does not match the domain specified for a content switching policy. If it does, requests are continuously redirected to the unavailable virtual server.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: rhistate
options.description: A host route is injected according to the setting on the virtual servers             * If set to C(PASSIVE) on all the virtual servers that share the IP address, the appliance always injects the hostroute.             * If set to C(ACTIVE) on all the virtual servers that share the IP address, the appliance injects even if one virtual server is UP.             * If set to C(ACTIVE) on some virtual servers and C(PASSIVE) on the others, the appliance, injects even if one virtual server set to C(ACT

options.name: rtspnat
options.description: Enable network address translation (NAT) for real-time streaming protocol (RTSP) connections.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: servicetype
options.description: Protocol used by the virtual server.

options.name: sobackupaction
options.description: Action to be performed if spillover is to take effect, but no backup chain to spillover is usable or exists

options.name: somethod
options.description: Type of spillover used to divert traffic to the backup virtual server when the primary virtual server reaches the spillover threshold. Connection spillover is based on the number of connections. Bandwidth spillover is based on the total Kbps of incoming and outgoing traffic.

options.name: sopersistence
options.description: Maintain source-IP based persistence on primary and backup virtual servers.

options.name: sopersistencetimeout
options.description: Time-out value, in minutes, for spillover persistence.

options.name: sothreshold
options.description: Depending on the spillover method, the maximum number of connections or the maximum total bandwidth (Kbps) that a virtual server can handle before spillover occurs.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(enabled), the resource will be enabled on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(disabled), the resource will be disabled on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(renamed), the res

options.description: Enable state updates for a specific content switching virtual server. By default, the Content Switching virtual server is always UP, regardless of the state of the Load Balancing virtual servers bound to it. options.name: targettype
options.description: Virtual server target type.

options.name: tcpprobeport
options.description: Port number for external TCP probe. NetScaler provides support for external TCP health check of the vserver status over the selected port. This option is only supported for vservers assigned with an IPAddress or ipset.

options.name: tcpprofilename
options.description: Name of the TCP profile containing TCP configuration settings for the virtual server.

options.name: td
options.description: Integer value that uniquely identifies the traffic domain in which you want to configure the entity. If you do not specify an ID, the entity becomes part of the default traffic domain, which has an ID of 0.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time period for which a persistence session is in effect.

options.name: v6persistmasklen
options.description: Persistence mask for IP based persistence types, for IPv6 virtual servers.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vipheader
options.description: Name of virtual server IP and port header, for use with the VServer IP Port Insertion parameter.
